messages.subject: Document Request: CLM-2024-003
messages.body:
Dear Policyholder,

With reference to your claim CLM-2024-003, we require the following additional document to process your claim:

1. Fire brigade report

Reason: Independent verification of the fire incident is required per our standard claims procedure.

Please submit the document within 15 days to avoid delay in claim processing.

Regards,
Claims Team

messages.subject: Re: Document Request: CLM-2024-003
messages.body:
Hello,

Please find attached the fire brigade report as requested. The report confirms the fire started due to an electrical short circuit.

Please process my claim at the earliest.

Regards
